subject: Pricing follow-up: target $/1M token benchmarking vs OpenAI/Anthropic
messages:
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>
To: Alex Duron <alex.duron@acme.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-03-28T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Follow-up + quick numbers (post-discovery)

Hi Alex 
great to meet today. Quick recap and next steps from our call:

- Use case: in-product assistant (search + summarization + 1:1 convo) for support flows.
- Target go-live: Q3 pilot, broad roll in Q4 if pilot goes well.
- Key constraints: latency under 400ms p95 for chat flows, data residency in US, predictable unit cost.

To help us put together a tailored pilot quote, can you confirm two quick items:
1) Estimated token volumes (monthly): typical and peak (1M tokens increments ok)
2) Target price /1M tokens you need to hit (or budget range) 

helps us map to Dedicated vs Hosted pricing and batching/quantization options

We shared a one-pager during the call (attached) 
will follow with a draft MUTUAL ACTION PLAN when we have the numbers.

Attachments: redwood-pricing-1pager.pdf

Thanks 
available if you want to hop on a quick 15-min follow-up today.












-- Vanessa Ortiz
Senior AE, Redwood Inference
vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com | (415) 555-0187
From: Alex Duron <alex.duron@acme.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>
Cc: Procurement <procurement@acme.com>
Date: 2027-03-28T10:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Follow-up + quick numbers (post-discovery)

Thanks Vanessa 
good call. High level numbers from our side:

- Typical monthly tokens (prod): ~50M tokens/month
- Expected peak (seasonal): up to ~120M tokens/month for two-week spikes
- Internal target price: ideally around $700 / 1M tokens (we're under pressure from finance to come in <= $1k / 1M)
- Procurement note: budget range for pilot is ~$35k-$50k for the first quarter (covers infra + service)

If you can show a credible path to ~$700/1M with predictable latency, we'll prioritize a pilot. Let me know what additional data you need.




-- Alex Duron
Product Lead, Integrations 
Acme Corp
alex.duron@acme.com
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-03-28T10:12:00-07:00
Subject: Fwd: Re: Follow-up + quick numbers (post-discovery) 






Looping you both 
Alex confirmed 50M typical / 120M peak and target ~$700 / 1M (finance wants <= $1k / 1M). Pilot budget ~$35k-50k.

Can we quickly confirm:
- Realistic Redwood unit economics at 50M tokens/month (hosted vs dedicated) incl. expected margin?
- Benchmark vs OpenAI/Anthropic and other open-model hosts for comparable quality (approx $/1M) 
want to call this out in the commercial.
- Any recommended pricing tiers or pilot structure to hit their budget and show cost saving at scale?

Attaching the token forecast they shared. Short timeline here 
can you both weigh in in the next 90 minutes?

Attachments: acme-token-forecast.xlsx

Thanks 
I can join a quick sync if helpful.

-- Vanessa
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-03-28T11:32:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Re: Follow-up + quick numbers (post-discovery) 


Thanks 
quick high-level take (90-min turnaround):

1) Redwood economics (ballpark, hosted pricing with SLOs):
   - At 50M tokens/mo: list price ~ $950 / 1M tokens; with pilot discount (commitment + 3mo) we can go to ~$700 / 1M and still cover infra + ops.
   - Dedicated (reserved capacity) can bring unit cost down to ~$420-550 / 1M depending on GPU mix and quantization (we assume 4-bit quantized open model variant).

2) Competitor benchmarking (approx $/1M tokens for comparable latency/quality):
   - OpenAI (higher-quality multi-turn models): ~$1,500 / 1M (varies by model; gpt-4-class pricing implied)
   - Anthropic (Claude-class): ~$1,200 / 1M (enterprise tiers)
   - Open-model hosts/self-managed optimized stack: ~$400-800 / 1M depending on infra and engineering overhead

3) Recommendation for ACME pilot:
   - Offer a 3-month pilot at $700 / 1M (committed up to 60M tokens/mo) with automatic switch to Dedicated pricing if sustained >80M/mo for 2 consecutive months.
   - Include performance SLA (p95 < 400ms) and 30-day rollback clause.
   - Provide a clear end-state projection showing Dedicated would hit ~$450 / 1M at 120M tokens/mo 
good marketing for finance.

I'll draft a short commercial/quote template and M.A.P. with these numbers. Aditya 
can you confirm feasibility of the Dedicated price band and any caveats on quantization/latency?

-- Marissa Cole
Director, Solutions 
Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com
